market_view.rationale: Massive FII net buying exceeding ₹29,000 crore over three sessions has catalyzed a sharp large-cap breakout, pushing Nifty 50 and Bank Nifty over 2% higher and restoring 50-day breadth to 47.69%. While an elevated VIX at 17.47 and ongoing small-cap lag (-0.82%) require disciplined position sizing, institutional momentum clearly favors front-line large caps.

sector_pick.name: NIFTY IT
sector_pick.rationale: Continues to display dominant relative strength with an 18.81% one-month return, remaining the premier structural leader for swing trades.

last_week_review: Last week's call held up accurately as the NIFTY IT sector continued its strong relative outperformance while broader mid- and small-cap indices remained subdued.
